title: Smoky Beef Skewers Recipe
description: Delicious, smoky beef skewers perfect for grilling. Serve with your favorite sides for a quick and tasty meal.

ingredients.name: Beef (sirloin or ribeye), cut into 1 inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut beef into uniform pieces for even cooking.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a mixture of light and dark soy sauce for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Brown sugar adds a rich, caramel flavor to the beef.

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic helps to bring out the beef’s natural flavors.

ingredients.name: Ginger, grated
ingredients.notes: Grated ginger adds a nice, warm spice to the dish.

ingredients.name: Smoky sauce (such as hoisin or oyster sauce)
ingredients.notes: Smoky sauce gives the beef a nice, savory flavor.

ingredients.name: Chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Chili flakes add a nice kick to the dish.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use olive oil to brush the skewers before grilling.

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Add salt and pepper to taste.

instructions: Thread beef onto skewers, leaving 1/4 inch space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, smoky sauce, and chili flakes.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of at least 145°F.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
